segments.source: Streaming an AR experience
segments.ko: AR 경험 스트리밍

segments.source: **Framework**: ARKit
segments.ko: **프레임워크**: ARKit

segments.source: Control an AR experience remotely by transferring sensor and user input over the network.
segments.ko: 네트워크를 통해 센서 데이터와 사용자 입력을 전송하여 AR 경험을 원격으로 제어합니다.

segments.source: **Availability**:
segments.ko: **Availability**:

segments.source: iPadOS 13.0+
segments.ko: iPadOS 13.0+

segments.source: Mac Catalyst 13.0+
segments.ko: Mac Catalyst 13.0+

segments.source: Xcode 16.0+
segments.ko: Xcode 16.0+

segments.source: Overview
segments.ko: Overview

segments.source: The sample app, AR Stream, shares the augmented camera feed with a peer device, and enables it to take control by interacting with the remote AR experience.
segments.ko: 샘플 앱 AR Stream은 증강 카메라 피드를 피어 장치와 공유하고, 원격 AR 경험에 대한 상호작용을 통해 피어가 제어할 수 있게 합니다.

segments.source: For example, a user shares their screen depicting their physical environment with a computer technician who assists the user with troubleshooting a hardware issue.
segments.ko: 예를 들어 사용자가 물리적 환경을 보여 주는 화면을 하드웨어 문제를 진단해 주는 컴퓨터 기술자와 공유할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: As the user views a broken device resting on a table from different angles, the remote technician interacts with the experience by augmenting the user’s camera feed with textual annotations that describe the necessary steps to repair the device.
segments.ko: 사용자가 테이블 위에 놓인 고장난 장치를 여러 각도에서 보는 동안, 원격 기술자는 사용자의 카메라 피드에 텍스트 주석을 추가해 기기 수리 단계에 필요한 작업을 설명함으로써 상호작용합니다.

segments.source: ![An illustration of a user's device viewing an AR experience in front of a real-world computer tower on a table.
segments.ko: ![실제 컴퓨터 타워 앞에서 사용자의 장치가 실제 환경의 AR 경험을 보는 모습을 보여 주는 삽화.

segments.source: The screen displays the tower through the device’s camera feed, which the app augments with explanatory text that the remote technician creates.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/e0bb1908e2ec930a83a07e11d1f863f6/ar-streaming-hero.png)
segments.ko: 화면은 기기의 카메라 피드를 통해 타워를 표시하며, 앱은 원격 기술자가 생성한 설명 텍스트로 이를 증강합니다.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/e0bb1908e2ec930a83a07e11d1f863f6/ar-streaming-hero.png)

segments.source: To enable the remote user to see the user’s physical environment, AR Stream shares device sensor information across the network.
segments.ko: 원격 사용자가 사용자의 물리적 환경을 볼 수 있도록 AR Stream은 네트워크를 통해 장치 센서 정보를 공유합니다.

segments.source: By compressing camera frames with [`Video Toolbox`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/VideoToolbox), the app provides the peer with good visibility of the user’s view by displaying the remote experience at a high frame rate.
segments.ko: [`Video Toolbox`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/VideoToolbox)로 카메라 프레임을 압축해 앱은 고프레임률로 원격 경험을 표시하고 피어가 사용자의 화면을 선명하게 볼 수 있도록 합니다.

segments.source: AR Stream also sends mathematical details about the user’s real-world pose to the remote user to process the peer’s touch input.
segments.ko: AR Stream은 또한 사용자의 실제 자세에 대한 수학적 세부 정보를 원격 사용자에게 전달해 피어의 터치 입력을 처리합니다.

segments.source: The sample app sends the session’s inverse view and inverse projection matrices to the remote device so it can calculate a location in the user’s environment where the remote user taps.
segments.ko: 샘플 앱은 세션의 역 뷰 행렬과 역 투영 행렬을 원격 장치로 전송해 원격 사용자가 탭한 사용자의 환경 내 위치를 계산할 수 있게 합니다.

segments.source: To indicate when the remote user taps the screen, AR Stream places a helpful virtual indicator at the tap location.
segments.ko: 원격 사용자가 화면을 탭했음을 표시하기 위해 AR Stream은 탭 위치에 유용한 가상 표시기를 배치합니다.

segments.source: Display a Camera Feed and Monitor the Session
segments.ko: 카메라 피드 표시 및 세션 모니터링

segments.source: AR Stream displays the device’s camera feed by configuring a window with a view controller that displays an [`ARView`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/ARView) (see the sample project’s `Main.storyboard` file).
segments.ko: AR Stream는 [`ARView`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/ARView)를 표시하는 뷰 컨트롤러가 포함된 창을 구성해 장치의 카메라 피드를 표시합니다(샘플 프로젝트의 `Main.storyboard` 파일 참조).

segments.source: By default,[`ARView`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/ARView) runs a session with a world-tracking configuration [`ARWorldTrackingConfiguration`](arworldtrackingconfiguration.md).
segments.ko: 기본적으로 [`ARView`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/ARView)는 world-tracking 구성 [`ARWorldTrackingConfiguration`](arworldtrackingconfiguration.md)으로 세션을 실행합니다.

segments.source: To receive notifications of the view’s session events, the project’s view controller (see `ViewController` in the sample project) assigns itself as the session delegate.
segments.ko: 뷰의 세션 이벤트 알림을 수신하려면, 샘플 프로젝트의 뷰 컨트롤러(샘플 프로젝트의 `ViewController` 참고)는 자신을 세션 델리게이트로 지정합니다.

segments.source:
```swift
arView.session.delegate = self
```
segments.ko:
```swift
arView.session.delegate = self
```

segments.source: Capture Frames
segments.ko: 프레임 캡처

segments.source: To show the user’s physical environment to the remote user, AR Stream uses ReplayKit to open a screen-recording session with [`RPScreenRecorder`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/ReplayKit/RPScreenRecorder).
segments.ko: 사용자의 물리적 환경을 원격 사용자에게 표시하기 위해 AR Stream는 [`RPScreenRecorder`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/ReplayKit/RPScreenRecorder)를 사용해 스크린 녹화 세션을 엽니다.

segments.source: The screen recording captures the contents of the app’s main window, which includes any augmentations that RealityKit may add to the camera feed.
segments.ko: 스크린 녹화는 앱의 기본 창 내용을 캡처하며, 여기에는 RealityKit이 카메라 피드에 추가할 수 있는 증강 내용이 포함됩니다.

segments.source: In the [`startCapture(handler:completionHandler:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/ReplayKit/RPScreenRecorder/startCapture(handler:completionHandler:)) closure, the sample project passes the captured screen (`sampleBuffer`) to the `compressAndSend` function for eventual transmission over the network.
segments.ko: [`startCapture(handler:completionHandler:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/ReplayKit/RPScreenRecorder/startCapture(handler:completionHandler:)) 클로저에서 샘플 프로젝트는 캡처된 화면(`sampleBuffer`)을 네트워크 전송을 위해 `compressAndSend` 함수에 전달합니다.

segments.source: The sample project also passes in the session’s current frame to conform the screen captures to the camera-image size.
segments.ko: 샘플 프로젝트는 또한 세션의 현재 프레임을 전달해 화면 캡처가 카메라 이미지 크기에 맞춰지도록 합니다.

segments.source: **Note**: Although [`ARView`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/ARView) provides a [`snapshot(saveToHDR:completion:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/ARView/snapshot(saveToHDR:completion:)-66jzu) function to capture the contents of the view, ReplayKit’s screen recording is more conducive to real-time capture.
segments.ko: **Note**: [`ARView`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/ARView)는 뷰의 내용을 캡처하는 [`snapshot(saveToHDR:completion:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/ARView/snapshot(saveToHDR:completion:)-66jzu) 함수를 제공하지만, ReplayKit의 스크린 녹화가 실시간 캡처에 더 적합합니다.

segments.source: Compress and Send Frames to the Peer
segments.ko: 피어에 프레임 압축 및 전송

segments.source: The sample project’s `VideoProcessor` class implements the `compressAndSend` function, which uses [`VTCompressionSession`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/VideoToolbox/VTCompressionSession) to compress the captured video frames.
segments.ko: 샘플 프로젝트의 `VideoProcessor` 클래스는 `compressAndSend` 함수를 구현하며, 이 함수는 [`VTCompressionSession`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/VideoToolbox/VTCompressionSession)을 사용해 캡처된 비디오 프레임을 압축합니다.

segments.source:
```swift
VTCompressionSessionEncodeFrame(compressionSession,
    imageBuffer: imageBuffer,
    presentationTimeStamp: presentationTimeStamp,
    duration: .invalid,
    frameProperties: nil,
    infoFlagsOut: nil) {
```
segments.ko:
```swift
VTCompressionSessionEncodeFrame(compressionSession,
    imageBuffer: imageBuffer,
    presentationTimeStamp: presentationTimeStamp,
    duration: .invalid,
    frameProperties: nil,
    infoFlagsOut: nil) {
```

segments.source: To ensure timely compression for the real-time streaming use case of the app, the video processor enables the compression session’s [`kVTCompressionPropertyKey_RealTime`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/VideoToolbox/kVTCompressionPropertyKey_RealTime) option.
segments.ko: 앱의 실시간 스트리밍 사용 사례에서 적시에 압축되도록 비디오 프로세서는 압축 세션의 [`kVTCompressionPropertyKey_RealTime`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/VideoToolbox/kVTCompressionPropertyKey_RealTime) 옵션을 활성화합니다.

segments.source:
```swift
VTSessionSetProperty(compressionSession, key: kVTCompressionPropertyKey_RealTime,
    value: kCFBooleanTrue)
```
segments.ko:
```swift
VTSessionSetProperty(compressionSession, key: kVTCompressionPropertyKey_RealTime,
    value: kCFBooleanTrue)
```

segments.source: After the [`VTCompressionSession`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/VideoToolbox/VTCompressionSession) finishes encoding a frame, the app creates a `VideoFrameData` instance using the compressed frame and the inverse view and projection matrices from the corresponding [`ARFrame`](arframe.md).
segments.ko: [`VTCompressionSession`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/VideoToolbox/VTCompressionSession)이 프레임 인코딩을 완료하면 앱은 해당 [`ARFrame`](arframe.md)에서 가져온 역투영 행렬과 역뷰 행렬을 사용해 `VideoFrameData` 인스턴스를 생성합니다.

segments.source: The project serializes and encodes the `VideoFrameData` as JSON data, and passes the data to its `sendHandler`.
segments.ko: 프로젝트는 `VideoFrameData`를 JSON 데이터로 직렬화해 인코딩하고, 해당 데이터를 `sendHandler`로 전달합니다.

segments.source: The screen-recording closure defines the send handler to contain code that uses [`Multipeer Connectivity`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/MultipeerConnectivity) to transmit the video data over the local network.
segments.ko: 스크린 녹화 클로저는 데이터 전송을 위해 로컬 네트워크 상에서 `VideoFrameData`를 전송하는 코드가 포함된 [`Multipeer Connectivity`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/MultipeerConnectivity) send handler를 정의합니다.

segments.source:
```swift
multipeerSession.sendToAllPeers(data, reliably: true)
```
segments.ko:
```swift
multipeerSession.sendToAllPeers(data, reliably: true)
```

segments.source: Receive and Decompress Peer Frames
segments.ko: 피어 프레임 수신 및 디컴프레스

segments.source: When the app receives `VideoFrameData` from another device, it decodes the JSON data.
segments.ko: 앱이 다른 장치에서 `VideoFrameData`를 받으면 JSON 데이터를 디코딩합니다.

segments.source: To house the transmitted video frame, AR Stream reconstructs a sample buffer.
segments.ko: 전송된 비디오 프레임을 보관하려면 AR Stream가 샘플 버퍼를 재구성합니다.

segments.source: The system can display only uncompressed data, so the video processor decompresses the video frame using [`VTDecompressionSession`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/VideoToolbox/VTDecompressionSession) within its `decompress` function.
segments.ko: 시스템은 비압축 데이터만 표시할 수 있으므로 비디오 프로세서는 `decompress` 함수 내에서 [`VTDecompressionSession`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/VideoToolbox/VTDecompressionSession)을 사용해 비디오 프레임을 디컴프레스합니다.

segments.source:
```swift
VTDecompressionSessionDecodeFrame(decompressionSession,
    sampleBuffer: sampleBuffer,
    flags: [],
    infoFlagsOut: nil) {
```
segments.ko:
```swift
VTDecompressionSessionDecodeFrame(decompressionSession,
    sampleBuffer: sampleBuffer,
    flags: [],
    infoFlagsOut: nil) {
```

segments.source: AR Stream draws the video frame to the screen using its renderer object (see `Renderer` in the sample project).
segments.ko: AR Stream는 샘플 프로젝트의 렌더러 객체(샘플 프로젝트의 `Renderer` 참조)를 사용해 비디오 프레임을 화면에 그립니다.

segments.source: The renderer enqueues the frame data for imminent display.
segments.ko: 렌더러는 즉시 표시할 수 있도록 프레임 데이터를 큐에 넣습니다.

segments.source:
```swift
// Update the PipView aspect ratio to match the camera-image dimensions.
let width = CGFloat(CVPixelBufferGetWidth(imageBuffer))
let height = CGFloat(CVPixelBufferGetHeight(imageBuffer))
overlayViewController?.setPipViewConstraints(width: width, height: height)

overlayViewController?.renderer.enqueueFrame(
    pixelBuffer: imageBuffer,
    presentationTimeStamp: presentationTimeStamp,
    inverseProjectionMatrix: videoFrameData.inverseProjectionMatrix,
    inverseViewMatrix: videoFrameData.inverseViewMatrix)
```
segments.ko:
```swift
// Update the PipView aspect ratio to match the camera-image dimensions.
let width = CGFloat(CVPixelBufferGetWidth(imageBuffer))
let height = CGFloat(CVPixelBufferGetHeight(imageBuffer))
overlayViewController?.setPipViewConstraints(width: width, height: height)

overlayViewController?.renderer.enqueueFrame(
    pixelBuffer: imageBuffer,
    presentationTimeStamp: presentationTimeStamp,
    inverseProjectionMatrix: videoFrameData.inverseProjectionMatrix,
    inverseViewMatrix: videoFrameData.inverseViewMatrix)
```

segments.source: Display the Remote Users Camera Feed
segments.ko: 원격 사용자 카메라 피드 표시

segments.source: AR Stream defines an [`MTKView`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/MetalKit/MTKView) subclass, `OverlayViewController`, that displays the remote user’s camera feed on top of the [`ARView`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/ARView) by placing a *picture-in-picture* (PiP) view at the bottom left of the screen.
segments.ko: AR Stream는 [`MTKView`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/MetalKit/MTKView) 하위 클래스 `OverlayViewController`를 정의하며, 화면 왼쪽 아래에 *picture-in-picture* (PiP) 보기를 배치해 [`ARView`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/ARView) 위에 원격 사용자의 카메라 피드를 표시합니다.

segments.source: ![A screenshot of the app at launch that displays the camera feed of the user’s AR experience at full size.
segments.ko: ![앱 시작 시 사용자 AR 경험의 카메라 피드를 전체 크기로 표시한 앱의 스크린샷

segments.source: At the bottom left, the app overlays a smaller view — or PiP view — that represents the camera feed of the remote user’s experience.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/10a488f59f21fe469045f05871130c14/ar-streaming-pip-view.jpg)
segments.ko: 화면 왼쪽 아래에는 원격 사용자의 경험 카메라 피드를 나타내는 더 작은 보기(또는 PiP 보기)를 오버레이합니다.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/10a488f59f21fe469045f05871130c14/ar-streaming-pip-view.jpg)

segments.source: The sample project’s `AppDelegate` configures the PiP view in a secondary window.
segments.ko: 샘플 프로젝트의 `AppDelegate`는 PiP 보기를 보조 창에서 구성합니다.

segments.source: Because ReplayKit’s screen recording captures only the main window, the PiP view displays only the remote user’s camera feed.
segments.ko: ReplayKit의 스크린 녹화는 기본 창만 캡처하므로 PiP 보기에는 원격 사용자의 카메라 피드만 표시됩니다.

segments.source: Send Gestures to the Peer
segments.ko: 피어로 제스처 전송

segments.source: When the remote user taps the PiP view, the project responds by recording the tap location.
segments.ko: 원격 사용자가 PiP 보기를 탭하면 프로젝트는 탭 위치를 기록해 반응합니다.

segments.source: The sample project uses the inverse matrices that the user sends to enable the remote user to interact with the user’s AR experience.
segments.ko: 샘플 프로젝트는 사용자가 전송한 역행렬을 사용해 원격 사용자가 사용자의 AR 경험과 상호작용할 수 있게 합니다.

segments.source: The project converts the tap location and inverse matrices into a ray cast that describes the location and direction in the user’s [`ARSession`](arsession.md) world coordinate system (see the `makeRay` function in the sample project).
segments.ko: 프로젝트는 탭 위치와 역행렬을 사용해 사용자 [`ARSession`](arsession.md) 월드 좌표계에서의 위치와 방향을 설명하는 광선 캐스트로 변환합니다(샘플 프로젝트의 `makeRay` 함수 참조).

segments.source:
```swift
let rayQuery = makeRay(from: location,
    viewportSize: view.frame.size,
    inverseProjectionMatrix: simd_float4x4(inverseProjectionMatrix),
    inverseViewMatrix: simd_float4x4(inverseViewMatrix))
```
segments.ko:
```swift
let rayQuery = makeRay(from: location,
    viewportSize: view.frame.size,
    inverseProjectionMatrix: simd_float4x4(inverseProjectionMatrix),
    inverseViewMatrix: simd_float4x4(inverseViewMatrix))
```

segments.source: Then, the sample project encodes the ray cast as JSON data and sends it to the connected peer.
segments.ko: 그런 다음 샘플 프로젝트는 광선 캐스트를 JSON 데이터로 인코딩해 연결된 피어로 전송합니다.

segments.source:
```swift
let data = try JSONEncoder().encode(rayQuery)
multipeerSession?.sendToAllPeers(data, reliably: true)
```
segments.ko:
```swift

multipeerSession?.sendToAllPeers(data, reliably: true)
```

segments.source: The project creates this visual marker using a ball-shaped [`ModelEntity`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/ModelEntity).
segments.ko: The project creates this visual marker using a ball-shaped [`ModelEntity`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/ModelEntity).

segments.source: At app launch, the marker is invisible by default as the project readies the marker for display by adding it to the scene.
segments.ko: At app launch, the marker is invisible by default as the project readies the marker for display by adding it to the scene.

segments.source:
```swift
arView.scene.addAnchor(marker)
```
segments.ko:
```swift
arView.scene.addAnchor(marker)
```

segments.source: When the app receives a `Ray` from the remote user and adjusts the marker’s position, the project displays the marker by enabling it.
segments.ko: When the app receives a `Ray` from the remote user and adjusts the marker’s position, the project displays the marker by enabling it.

segments.source:
```swift
marker.isEnabled = true
```

```swift
marker.isEnabled = true
```
